scheme_name: Exposure Visits To The Assam Legislative Assembly
description:
The "Exposure Visits To The Assam Legislative Assembly" scheme was launched by the Government of Assam in 2018. 

This initiative aims to enhance the understanding of democratic processes among citizens, particularly students and youth. 

The scheme is designed to provide firsthand exposure to the functioning of the legislative assembly. 

It allows participants to observe the proceedings of the assembly sessions. 

The initiative is part of a broader effort to promote civic engagement and awareness about governance. 

The objectives of the scheme include fostering a sense of responsibility among young citizens. 

It aims to educate participants about the legislative process and the role of elected representatives. 

The program also seeks to inspire youth to participate actively in democratic processes. 

The target audience primarily includes students from schools and colleges across Assam. 

The scheme aims to conduct exposure visits for at least 1,000 students annually. 

Each visit is structured to last for a full day. 

Participants are guided through various sessions of the assembly. 

They receive insights into the legislative process from experienced officials. 

The benefits of the scheme include increased awareness of governance among youth. 

Participants gain knowledge about how laws are made and debated. 

They also learn about the importance of active citizenship. 

The scheme provides a platform for students to interact with legislators. 

This interaction helps demystify the workings of the government. 

Eligibility for participation in the scheme is primarily focused on students. 

Students must be enrolled in recognized schools or colleges in Assam. 

There are no specific age limits mentioned for participation. 

However, priority is given to students in higher secondary and undergraduate programs. 

The application process for the exposure visits is straightforward. 

Interested institutions must submit a formal request to the Assam Legislative Assembly Secretariat. 

The request should include details about the number of students and accompanying faculty. 

Institutions must also provide a proposed date for the visit. 

The Assam Legislative Assembly Secretariat reviews the applications. 

Upon approval, a confirmation is sent to the institution regarding the visit. 

Required documents include a letter of request from the institution. 

Institutions may also need to provide a list of participating students. 

The timeline for the visits is flexible. 

Exposure visits are organized throughout the academic year. 

The assembly sessions typically run from January to March and from July to September. 

Visits are scheduled to coincide with assembly sessions whenever possible. 

The Assam Legislative Assembly Secretariat is the primary implementing authority. 

The contact details for the Assam Legislative Assembly Secretariat are available on their official website. 

The Secretariat can be reached via email or phone for any inquiries regarding the scheme. 

The initiative has seen participation from various educational institutions across Assam. 

Feedback from participants has been overwhelmingly positive. 

Many students express increased interest in politics and governance after their visits. 

The scheme aligns with the broader national agenda of promoting democratic values. 

It also complements other educational initiatives aimed at youth empowerment. 

The Assam government has allocated a budget of INR 10 lakh for this scheme annually. 

This budget covers logistical expenses for the visits. 

It includes transportation costs and provisions for meals for participants. 

The scheme also aims to involve local NGOs in facilitating discussions during visits. 

This collaboration enhances the educational experience for participants. 

The exposure visits are designed to be interactive and engaging. 

Students are encouraged to ask questions during assembly sessions. 

This interaction fosters a deeper understanding of legislative processes. 

The initiative also includes post-visit feedback sessions. 

These sessions allow participants to reflect on their experiences. 

They can share their learnings and insights with peers. 

The scheme has a significant impact on promoting democratic literacy. 

It empowers students to become informed citizens. 

The Assam Legislative Assembly has reported an increase in youth engagement. 

This engagement is evident in subsequent participation in civic activities. 

The scheme is part of Assam's commitment to nurturing future leaders. 

It aims to create a generation that values democratic principles. 

The exposure visits also serve as a model for similar initiatives in other states. 

The Assam government encourages replication of this scheme nationwide. 

Overall, the "Exposure Visits To The Assam Legislative Assembly" scheme is a vital initiative. 

It plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between youth and governance. 

The scheme has the potential to inspire active participation in democracy. 

It equips students with the knowledge and skills necessary for civic engagement. 

This initiative is a testament to the Assam government's dedication to education and democracy. 

The scheme continues to evolve based on participant feedback and changing needs. 

Future plans include expanding the number of visits and enhancing the curriculum. 

The Assam government remains committed to fostering an informed citizenry. 

This commitment is reflected in the ongoing support for the exposure visits. 

The initiative is expected to grow in scope and impact in the coming years. 

It represents a significant step towards empowering the youth of Assam. 

Through this scheme, the government aims to cultivate a culture of participation. 

This culture is essential for the health of democracy in Assam and India as a whole.
